display_long_description:
Paint Anything. Get roasted.


In this VR Painting App, the world reacts to your art. NPCs analyze your paintings, leave comments, roast your work, and sometimes even offer to buy it.

This isn’t just a painting tool — it’s a creative sandbox with drama.

Paint ugly art. 
Get reactions. 
Earn money. 
Discover weird art styles. 
Build your own gallery.

Made for casual players. No painting skills needed — just paint anything and see if it sells.

Key features:

- 4 painting modes: E-Ink, Acrylic, Oil and Watercolor
- Realistic Oil Simulation
- 12 unique  art spaces to explore
- 12 quirky NPCs with different art preferences
- Story Mode: 4 story act with 8 unlockable scenes
- Sandbox Mode for stress-free creativity
- Paint-by-number sets
- Commission-based Work
